# Positioning

Tidewater is the dispatch board for regional moving crews. It books each job, assigns the crew and the truck, and texts the customer an arrival window.

The alternative our customers use today is a whiteboard and a group text.

In May we stopped calling Tidewater an all-in-one moving CRM. We do not do quoting, invoicing or customer records, and the all-in-one claim lost us deals to tools that do.
